final_message:
All 6 visible tests pass, plus documented edge-case checks. Bugs fixed:

1. `ledger/money.py` — `format_cents`: negative amounts produced `-4.90`-style output because floor division/modulo break on negatives; now normalizes with `abs()` so `-$3.10` / `-$0.05` render correctly.
2. `ledger/parse.py` — `parse_date`: returned `(y, d, m)`; day and month were swapped. Now returns `(year, month, day)`.
3. `ledger/report.py` — `top_items`: sorted totals ascending with no tie-break, returning the smallest items. Now sorts by total descending, ties broken by item name ascending, as the docstring requires.
